/nexlev-series/woody/baobab.html.description: Baobab is a park bench from the Woody series, with a slatted seat and backrest in dark brown on angled black legs. It seats 3 to 4 people and measures 6'6" x 2'6". Set beside a play area, it gives parents a place to sit and watch without standing inside a safe zone. Housing societies, resorts, public parks and college campuses also use benches like this along walking paths and lawns. The brown finish matches the other Woody pieces, so a site can keep one look across its play equipment and seating. It is garden furniture, so it does not need impact flooring. Our 3-year warranty on galvanised pipe and composite laminates applies to the parts made of those materials. Tell us how many benches your layout needs and where your paths run.
/nexlev-series/woody/baobab.html.spec_paragraph: Baobab stands on a black steel frame and can be fixed self-standing or grouted into a paved or soft base. Leave the 9'6" x 5'6" area listed for it clear, so people can sit down and get up easily. Wipe the slats after the monsoon and check the frame bolts at routine services.

/nexlev-series/woody/beaber.html.description: Beaber looks like two small wooden huts on stilts, joined high above the ground by a net crawl tunnel. One hut has a pitched roof and a climbing wall with red holds below it. From the decks, green and purple slides come down, including a spiral tube slide and an open spiral slide. Children climb in, crawl across and choose their slide on the way down. Beaber takes 35 to 40 children and covers 32'2" x 19'5", with a safe play area of 38'2" x 25'5". The hut look suits resorts, farmhouse clubs and society gardens with plenty of trees. The only skill listed for it is positive thinking. Warranty for the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded slides, composite laminates and play rope is 3 years. Ask us for a quote.
/nexlev-series/woody/beaber.html.spec_paragraph: Beaber's huts stand on posts with roto-moulded slides and a play rope tunnel between the decks. It is installed self-standing or grouted. The tunnel is the highest point, so lay impact flooring below it as well as at each slide exit. Check the tunnel net and the roof panels at routine services.

/nexlev-series/woody/colga.html.description: Colga puts a play tower, a balance beam and a swing set in one line. Children climb the wall or the panels to the tower, cross a bridge and pick the green slide or the blue one. Others wait their turn at the swing set on one end. Colga is meant for 30 to 35 children. Its product area is 33'2" x 21'5" and the safe play area is 39'2" x 27'5", so it needs a long open patch such as a school ground or a park lawn. Strength, team building, hand and eye coordination and concentration are the skills it is listed for. It is a Woody series piece in mixed colours. The 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipe, roto-moulded slides, composite laminates and play rope. Tell us your ground size and the ages you expect.
/nexlev-series/woody/colga.html.spec_paragraph: Colga combines climbing and swinging, so plan the swing end with clear space in front and behind. The structure is installed self-standing or grouted. Lay impact flooring under the balance beam, the slides and the swings, all inside the 39'2" x 27'5" zone. Swing bearings and spare parts carry 1 year of cover.

/nexlev-series/woody/conifer.html.description: Conifer is a mid-sized wooden play station with activity panels at ground level and slides up top. A blue double slide lets two children go down side by side, and a separate red slide gives a third way out. To reach the deck, children use a climbing panel and cross a rope ladder bridge. The ground-level panels give younger or less confident children something to do without climbing. Conifer takes 20 to 25 children and needs a product area of 20'9" x 16'7", with a safe play area of 26'9" x 22'7". Listed skills include self-directed play, strength, flexibility, hand and eye coordination and confidence. It suits preschools, society gardens and the junior section of a school. The galvanised frame, moulded slides and panels, laminates and rope are under warranty for 3 years. Ask us for a drawing.
/nexlev-series/woody/conifer.html.spec_paragraph: Conifer is installed self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Its slides are roto-moulded and the bridge uses play rope. Keep the 26'9" x 22'7" area clear and lay impact flooring at the foot of the double slide, where two children land together. Check the rope ladder bridge and panel fixings regularly.

/nexlev-series/woody/el-dorado.html.description: El Dorado is an open play frame with angled brown posts and Cherry Red play parts. Its main features are a wide twin wave slide, a traverse of hanging rings and a red climbing panel, with a rope net and a ring climber at the back. There is no roof or enclosed deck, so adults standing nearby can see every child. El Dorado suits children who like to hang and swing by their arms, and it fits a school ground or society play area of moderate size. It holds 20 to 25 children. The product area is 20'11" x 17'6" and the safe play area is 26'11" x 23'6". Skills listed are confidence, creative thinking and problem solving. El Dorado's galvanised pipes, moulded parts, laminates and play rope come with 3 years of cover. Send us your site size and age group.
/nexlev-series/woody/el-dorado.html.spec_paragraph: The El Dorado frame is triangular in plan, which keeps it steady once installed self-standing or grouted. Children hang from the ring traverse, so lay impact flooring under its full length and at the twin slide exit. Check the rings, their hangers and the rope net at each service.

/nexlev-series/woody/montana.html.description: Montana is a multi-tower play structure in Baby Blue and Mango Yellow, from the Woody series of our NexLev range. A bridge links its towers, a spiral tube slide winds down from one of them, and a net climber and a climbing wall offer two ways up. A swing hangs at one end for children who want a break from climbing. The two light colours stand out clearly against a green lawn. Montana takes 40 to 45 children and covers 27'1" x 23'6". With a safe play area of 33'1" x 29'6", it suits township parks, resorts and bigger society gardens. Its listed skills are confidence building, creative thinking and problem solving. We cover the galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope on Montana for 3 years. Send us your site photos and we will suggest where it goes.
/nexlev-series/woody/montana.html.spec_paragraph: Montana's towers, bridge and swing beam are galvanised pipe, with a roto-moulded tube slide and play rope nets. Installation is self-standing or grouted. The swing needs its own clear space, so do not place benches near that end of the 33'1" x 29'6" zone. Inspect swing parts and bridge fixings at routine services.

/nexlev-series/woody/skuhoom.html.description: Skuhoom is a large brown play frame that combines a rock climbing wall, monkey bars, a rope net, a slide and a swing beam. Its product area is 35'2" x 30'11" and its safe play area 41'2" x 36'11". That calls for a big site such as a township park, a resort lawn or a large school ground. It is listed for 40 to 45 children. Most of the play here asks children to grip and pull, whether on the bars, the wall or the net. The skills it lists are hand and eye coordination and confidence. Its single brown colour gives it a natural look in a garden setting. Warranty on its galvanised pipe, moulded parts, laminates and rope is 3 years. Ask us for a site plan with Skuhoom drawn to scale.
/nexlev-series/woody/skuhoom.html.spec_paragraph: Skuhoom has several fall points: the monkey bars, the climbing walls and the swings. Lay impact flooring across the full 41'2" x 36'11" zone instead of only at the slide exit. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Check wall holds, bar fixings and swing hangers at every service.

/nexlev-series/woody/sundarban.html.description: Sundarban takes its name from the mangrove forest of the Bengal delta and gives children a small wooden play house with a single deck. A green slide comes off the deck, a climbing wall and a net climber lead up to it, and a nest swing hangs alongside. Children who prefer swinging to climbing still have something to do. Sundarban is compact, at 19'3" x 12'3", with a safe play area of 25'3" x 18'3". It takes 20 to 25 children and fits a preschool yard or the corner of a society garden. Skills listed are motor skills, self control and hand and eye coordination. It comes in mixed colours. We give a 3-year warranty on the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded slide, composite laminates and play rope. Share your corner size and we will check it.
/nexlev-series/woody/sundarban.html.spec_paragraph: Sundarban's house and swing beam are installed together, self-standing or grouted. The slide is roto-moulded and the net climber uses play rope. Within the 25'3" x 18'3" zone, keep the swing path and the slide exit apart. Check the nest swing hangers at each service, and lay impact flooring under the swing.

/nexlev-series/woody/teton.html.description: Teton is a single play tower with a Forest Green roof, in the Woody series of our NexLev range. Children go up a net ladder, play under the roof and come down a double slide. A ring traverse runs out from the tower, so they can also cross hand over hand under the overhead rings. The roof shades the deck on hot afternoons. Teton takes 30 to 35 children. It needs 23'7" x 22'7" for the product and 29'7" x 28'7" for the safe play area, a near-square shape for a society lawn or a school yard. Listed skills are strength, self control and motor skills. The 3-year warranty covers its galvanised pipe, moulded slide, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us how Teton fits beside your other equipment.
/nexlev-series/woody/teton.html.spec_paragraph: Teton's tower and ring traverse are installed self-standing or grouted. The double slide is roto-moulded and the net ladder is play rope. Lay impact flooring under the rings and at the slide exit, and keep the 29'7" x 28'7" zone clear. Check the ring hangers and roof fixings during routine maintenance.

/nexlev-series/woody/toss.html.description: Toss is a two-seat see saw with a brown beam, Mango Yellow seats and a tyre stop under each end. The tyres take the knock when a seat comes down, which makes the ride softer for both children. The beam is narrow, 7'11" x 1'5" in all, so Toss slips into a play area that is already quite full. Its safe play area is 12'11" x 5'5". Two children ride at a time, and keeping the rhythm going builds concentration and confidence. It belongs to the Woody series and matches the brown finish of its other pieces. The galvanised pipe and moulded seats have a 3-year warranty, with 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Tell us how many children use the area at a time and we will suggest a mix.
/nexlev-series/woody/toss.html.spec_paragraph: Toss is a simple piece with one moving joint at the centre of the beam. It can be fixed self-standing or grouted. Keep the 12'11" x 5'5" area clear and lay impact flooring under both seats. Check the centre joint and the tyre stops at every service, and replace a worn tyre before it splits.

/nexlev-series/woody/wiggle.html.description: Wiggle is a swing with two round nest seats in place of flat ones. The A-frame legs are brown, and the top beam and chains are Play Orange. A nest seat lets a child sit, kneel or lie down, which suits children who are not yet sure of themselves on a flat seat. Wiggle is listed for 2 users, one per seat. The frame covers 12'11" x 9' and the safe play area is 18'11" x 15'. Skills listed are confidence building and social skills. It is part of our NexLev Woody series and suits parks, societies and preschools. Our warranty is 3 years on galvanised pipe, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Call +91 902 830 2266 to add Wiggle to your layout.
/nexlev-series/woody/wiggle.html.spec_paragraph: Nest seats are wider than flat seats, so keep the full 18'11" x 15' zone clear and lay impact flooring under the whole swing path. Wiggle is installed self-standing or grouted. Check the chains, hangers and seat edges at every service, and replace worn links early.

/nexlev-series/woody/woody-go-round.html.description: Woody Go Round is a merry-go-round with a round wooden platform and hand rails in Mango Yellow and Cherry Red. Children hold the rails, push off with their feet, then jump on and ride, taking turns to push. It suits 4 to 8 children at a time. The platform covers 5'9" x 5'9" and the safe play area is 8'9" x 8'9", which keeps a clear ring around the spinning edge. That small footprint lets you add it to a society play area or a school ground without redrawing the whole layout. The listed skills are self control and confidence building. Galvanised pipe and laminates on it are covered for 3 years, and the bearing for 1 year. Ask us for a quote with the spinning zone shown.
/nexlev-series/woody/woody-go-round.html.spec_paragraph: The central bearing takes the load of every ride, so check it at each service as per our maintenance steps. Woody Go Round is installed self-standing or grouted, and it must be set level so it turns evenly. Lay impact flooring right around the platform and keep the 8'9" x 8'9" ring clear.
